component: Account Hub validity, touched fields and accessible error descriptions

quotes.text: Assert.ok(!input.validity.valid, "The input should still be invalid");

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original element sets native custom validity separately from its ARIA error properties. Accepted showError=false keeps that validity error while removing the visible invalid state, alert role and error description. The current test directly checks !input.validity.valid. The manual form chooses visibility from showErrors or whether the field was touched, while still collecting the error. When an error clears, the description helper restores visible help text where present. These later options are distinct from the original component; no form, CSS or screen-reader run occurred.
title: Account Hub can keep an input invalid while hiding its error presentation
